title: On Wearing the old coat every winter
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：wear　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wear 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the herder ① wore the old coat every winter twice over, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the herder ② wears the old coat every winter year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ wear the old coat every winter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ worn the old coat every winter before — a line in the ledger for December 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Wearing the old coat every winter twice over, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ wear the steps down to nothing year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Wear the steps down to nothing at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new neighbour from the next pasture ⑧ wears the steps down to nothing twice over every winter without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ wore the old coat every winter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To wear the old coat every winter, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the pasture remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the pasture forgets, somebody wears the old coat every winter year after year again and somebody must wear the old coat every winter twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 穿着（一般过去式 wore the old coat every winter：1989 年牧人头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 穿着（一般现在 wears the old coat every winter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 穿着（不定式 to wear the old coat every winter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 穿着（过去完成时 had worn the old coat every winter：1983 年十二月的牧群台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 穿着（动名词 wearing the old coat every winter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 磨损（wear the steps down to nothing：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去磨损把台阶磨得只剩一线）
G. v. 磨损（wear the steps down to nothing：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 穿着（后段两处：新来的邻人照例 wears the steps down to nothing，而母亲又一次 wore the old coat every winter）

answers.why: wear 意为“穿着”，1989 年牧人来回两遍穿着年年冬天穿那件旧外套，那是牧场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 wore。
wear 意为“穿着”，自那以后牧人年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 wears。
wear 意为“穿着”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯穿着年年冬天穿那件旧外套”，此处为不定式 to wear the old coat every winter。
wear 意为“穿着”，牧群台账里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1996 年之前就有人穿着过，故用过去完成时 had worn。
wear 意为“穿着”，牧人说“穿着年年冬天穿那件旧外套这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 wearing the old coat every winter 作主语。
wear 意为“磨损”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去磨损把台阶磨得只剩一线”，should ever 之后用原形 wear the steps down to nothing。
wear 意为“磨损”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻磨损把台阶磨得只剩一线（wear the steps down to nothing at once），以后再也不要提起。
wear 意为“穿着”，新来的邻人每个冬天都照例磨损把台阶磨得只剩一线，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 wears。
wear 意为“穿着”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍穿着年年冬天穿那件旧外套，用一般过去式 wore 叙述。
wear 意为“穿着”，结尾那句是母亲 2001 年的话：要穿着年年冬天穿那件旧外套，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和牧场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 wear 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the herder wore the old coat every winter twice over, and nobody in the pasture forgot it.
Even now the herder wears the old coat every winter year after year whenever the pasture asks.
Wearing the old coat every winter twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever wear the steps down to nothing year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next pasture wears the steps down to nothing twice over every winter, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother wore the old coat every winter again, and the pasture remembered that half.
